title: Questions and answers
lead: Short answers to questions often asked about asteroids, comets, impacts and the Minor Planet Center, with links to the sources and to pages on this site that go further.

topics.mpc: The Minor Planet Center and discoveries

limits: These answers are general information, not official statements of the Minor Planet Center or of any agency; the linked sources are authoritative.
Requests for help with homework or coursework, and reviews of personal theories, cannot be answered individually.
Questions about submitting observations, designations or MPC services are best sent to the MPC helpdesk, which is staffed for them.
